definitions.explanation: a place where work or labor is performed, especially manual or industrial work

examples.japanese: {作業場|さぎょうば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was an accident at the worksite.

examples.japanese: ⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{作業場|さぎょうば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: The craftsmen are working in the workshop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧{作業場|さぎょうば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I built a small workshop in my garden.

notes:
{作業場|さぎょうば} refers to a place where work, especially manual or industrial work, is done.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧: Work, operation
- ⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧: Place

ALTERNATIVE READING:
Also read as さぎょうじょう, with the same meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {作業場|さぎょうば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (to work at a workplace)
- {作業場|さぎょうば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧ (workplace safety)
- ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{作業場|さぎょうば} (factory workshop floor)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧ (factory)
- ⟦{工房|こうぼう}→工房：12418_koubou⟧ (workshop, studio - often for crafts)
- ⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧ (worksite, scene)
- ⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧ (workplace - general)
- ⟦アトリエ→アトリエ：10698_atorie⟧ (atelier, artist's studio)

USAGE:
- More specifically refers to the physical space where labor occurs
- Often associated with manufacturing, construction, or crafts
- Less formal than ⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧ which refers to workplace in general

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in workplace and industrial contexts.
